reviewContext.userProblem: On macOS WebKit a right press over Markdown preview text fires mousedown, selects the word under the pointer, then fires contextmenu. keepsNativeContextMenu sees that press-created selection, keeps the native menu, and right-drag pan never starts over text.
requiredOutcomes: A right press over text with no prior selection prevents the right mousedown and the contextmenu, clears any press-created selection, and later moves pan.
A selection that existed before the press keeps the native menu and is left untouched; editable targets keep the menu and are never cleared.
No press record (inactive pane, keyboard menu, Windows order after pointerup) falls back to the unchanged event-time rule.
Middle pan, PAN_SLOP, fling, Ctrl/Cmd+wheel zoom, chord release and the suppressMenu path are unchanged.
Regression vitests for the macOS mousedown->select->contextmenu order pass, including a rendered Markdown PreviewPane case.
bun run typecheck, bun run lint:biome, bun run test and test:dom exit 0; committed locally on main after an accepted integration review; no push.
nonGoals: No new exports, modules, global listeners, platform branches or composedPath.
No README.md change (the current wording stays accurate).
No edits to pane .tsx components, other pane vitest files, package.json, bun.lock, .riela/ or riela-lock.json.
No GUI launch; no git push.
constraints: Run Node-based vitest via: mise exec -- env PATH="$(mise where node)/bin:$PATH" bun run test:dom
Do not launch the GUI app; the supervising session performs the GUI re-check (user-accepted gap).
Commit messages must not contain AI attribution or Co-Authored-By lines; no emojis.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Snapshot selection state (hadSelection) at right-button press time: button-2 pointerdown while active always replaces the record; mousedown captures only when no record exists.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: WebKit's word selection is created between mousedown and contextmenu, so only a press-time snapshot distinguishes a user's prior selection from a press-created one (architecture.md#pan-gesture-contract, Press-time selection record).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: contextMenu rule order: (1) active pan/suppressMenu prevents; (2) editable target keeps; (3) press record present -> keep only if hadSelection, else prevent and removeAllRanges; (4) no record -> unchanged event-time rule.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Keeps 77c1236 behavior for pan/suppressMenu and editable targets while fixing the macOS order; rule 4 preserves Windows order and keyboard menus.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: preventDefault the right mousedown only when button 2, active, not editable, and hadSelection is false.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Stops WebKit from creating the word selection without affecting other buttons, editable fields or prior selections.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Clear the press record on pointerup, pointercancel, detach and contextmenu; not in end() or lostpointercapture.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Prevents stale records leaking into the next press while keeping the record alive through the macOS contextmenu that follows the press.

intentionalTradeoffs: jsdom cannot reproduce WebKit native word select or mousedown default-action semantics; real macOS behavior is confirmed by the supervising GUI re-check.
If WebKit selects the word after contextmenu, that selection is not cleared, but the menu is still prevented and the pan proceeds.
removeAllRanges is called only when hadSelection is false, so a pre-existing selection is never touched.
supportedEdgeCases: macOS order: pointerdown/mousedown -> simulated word selection -> contextmenu with no prior selection: prevented, selection cleared, moves pan.
Pre-existing user selection before the right press: native menu kept, selection untouched.
Editable target press: menu kept, no mousedown prevent, no clearing.
Windows order (contextmenu after pointerup, no record): event-time rule.
Next press replaces the previous record; inactive pane creates no record; detach removes listeners and record.
Middle-button pan has no record and prevents as before.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Real WebKit default-action timing differences not reproducible in jsdom.
Selection created by WebKit after contextmenu dispatch.
Keyboard-invoked context menus beyond the unchanged event-time rule.

acceptanceCriteria: Case (a): mousedown and contextmenu are prevented, the press-created selection is cleared, and later moves pan.
Case (b): a pre-existing selection keeps the native menu and stays untouched.
Editable, Windows-order, next-press, inactive and detach cases pass.
All previous previewPanZoom.vitest.ts cases pass unchanged.
